title: Give recurring decisions a fast path

chapters.title: A fast path for recurring decisions
chapters.text: Give recurring choices a faster route. The model stays available for everything the fast path passes on.

chapters.title: Teach. Certify. Activate.
chapters.text: Teach from human labels, or learn from decisio’s answers. Certify on separate examples and check the saving before serving.

chapters.title: Keep the policy. Send new facts.
chapters.text: Register shared rules once as context. Each state contains the facts that change. The model keeps both.

chapters.title: An eligible answer skips the model
chapters.text: The default static embedding plus classifier costs about 0.05 ms, or 50 microseconds, for short texts. No neural network runs on the CPU.

chapters.title: Keep decisio for the rest
chapters.text: A fallback pays for the static check, then the model read. With an illustrative 50 ms model budget, that is about 50.05 ms.

chapters.title: The share answered makes the saving
chapters.text: Assume 80% of requests skip a 50 ms model read. The estimated mean is 10.05 ms. This share and model budget are assumptions, not a combined benchmark.

chapters.title: One pattern. Many recurring choices.
chapters.text: Use it for support routing, moderation or refund eligibility. Enable fast_table, then measure and certify on your task and host.
